question: direct_outlets revision 1 was judged revise (flow-004, 0.64). Two required criteria still fail: long passes 182.5 per match (target 50-90) and short escapes 13% (target 20%). How should the next iteration handle them?

longPassFacts.mostLongPassesFrom: middle third under pressure after winning a second ball

escapeFacts.note: pressers stand in the lanes; the press works, so the long-ball side goes long

fix_pass_volume.summary: Investigate and fix the engine-wide pass volume (about 1.4x real) first, then re-measure long passes; this is the rulebook's calibration layer brought forward.
fix_pass_volume.tradeoffs: Touches decision timing for all teams; larger change; may fix the long-pass count at its root.

reduce_mid_third_long.summary: Make the direct side play forward on the ground or wide after winning a second ball in the middle third instead of going long again.
reduce_mid_third_long.tradeoffs: Targets the main source; risks scripting a style.

share_criterion.summary: Replace the absolute long-pass target with a share (15-25% of passes) and accept escapes at 13% as the press working, then move on to the next defect.
share_criterion.tradeoffs: Fast; relies on the argument that absolute counts are inflated by global volume.

weaken_press_lanes.summary: Lower the pressing side's lane coverage so more press-breaking passes are on.
weaken_press_lanes.tradeoffs: Raises escapes but weakens gegenpressing, possibly unrealistically.

criteria.share: Direct side long passes 15-25% of its passes.
criteria.absolute: Direct side long passes 50-90 per match.
criteria.volume: Passes per team per match 400-550 across the 24 scenarios.
criteria.escapes: Short escapes at least 20% of pressed build-ups.
criteria.keepGains: Clearances at most 40, support at least 2.5, isolated counter-press starts at most 30% stay met.
criteria.regression: All suites pass, finite, zero violations.
